verdict.rationale: LanceDB's own table API documents row deletion by SQL predicate (`table.delete("role = 'Traitor Knight'")`), so the deletion half of the story is covered. Retention control is not evidenced: the versioning docs describe snapshots and audit trails but nothing on pruning old versions, TTL policies, or guaranteeing deleted rows are purged from history. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or TTL, version cleanup or compaction to purge deleted data from snapshots, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Includes version control, data snapshots, and audit trails.
